summary: XRD analysis of CsPbBr3 quantum dots (QDs) treated with varying AgSCN content reveals that the crystal structure remains cubic across all samples, with consistent peak positions. The full-width at half-maximum (FWHM) of the (200) diffraction peak decreases with AgSCN addition up to 15 mg/ml, indicating improved crystallinity, but increases at 20 mg/ml, suggesting possible degradation or disorder at higher AgSCN concentrations.

key_findings.finding: XRD peak positions for CsPbBr3 QDs remain nearly unchanged with increasing AgSCN content, indicating retention of the cubic phase.
The FWHM of the (200) diffraction peak decreases as AgSCN content increases up to 15 mg/ml, then increases at 20 mg/ml.
A slight shift in the (200) peak position is observed with increasing AgSCN content.

scientific_interpretation.claim: The decrease in FWHM of the (200) peak up to 15 mg/ml AgSCN suggests improved crystallinity or increased crystallite size in CsPbBr3 QDs with moderate AgSCN treatment.
scientific_interpretation.reasoning: A reduction in FWHM typically indicates improved crystallinity or larger crystallite size. This trend is observed up to 15 mg/ml AgSCN, as shown by the FWHM values and the reported trend.

citations.evidence: FWHM of (200) peak decreases with increasing AgSCN content up to 15 mg/ml, then increases at 20 mg/ml

scientific_interpretation.claim: The increase in FWHM at 20 mg/ml AgSCN may indicate the onset of structural disorder or reduced crystallinity at higher AgSCN concentrations.
scientific_interpretation.reasoning: The FWHM increases at the highest AgSCN content, which is commonly associated with decreased crystallinity or increased microstrain.

citations.evidence: FWHM of (200) peak decreases with increasing AgSCN content up to 15 mg/ml, then increases at 20 mg/ml

scientific_interpretation.claim: The consistent peak positions across all AgSCN concentrations indicate that the cubic phase of CsPbBr3 is preserved throughout the treatment.
scientific_interpretation.reasoning: All samples, regardless of AgSCN content, show nearly identical peak positions, suggesting no phase transformation.

limitations.claim: No quantitative phase analysis or identification of secondary phases is provided, limiting the ability to detect minor impurity phases.
Lattice parameters are not reported, so subtle structural changes cannot be quantified.
The FWHM values are only reported for the (200) peak, so changes in other reflections are not assessed.

citations.evidence: Variation of (200) peak of the CsPbBr 3 QDs with the variation of AgSCN content.

limitations.claim: Peak intensity changes are not quantitatively analyzed, which could provide further insight into preferred orientation or phase fraction changes.

citations.evidence: No mention of intensity trends or quantitative intensity data.
